messages.軽いコストで敵の攻撃威力を下げ、次のターンに味方全員へクイックを配る、速度支援向: A low-cost starting E.G.O for Speed support: lowers enemy Attack Power and grants Haste to all allies next turn.
messages.攻撃威力減少: 的中時に攻撃威力減少2を付与する。解析Ⅱ以前は表面的中時だけ。: **Attack Power Down**: Inflicts 2 on hit. At Threadspin Ⅱ or below, requires a Heads Hit.
messages.クイック: 的中時に次のターンの全味方へクイック1(解析Ⅲで3)を付与し、味方の: **Haste**: On hit, grants all allies 1 Haste next turn, increased to 3 at Threadspin Ⅲ.
messages.束縛(解析Ⅳ): 的中時に次のターンへ束縛2を付与する。: **Bind (Threadspin Ⅳ)**: On hit, inflicts 2 Bind next turn.
messages.パッシブ「沈黙」: 被ダメージ時に次のターンの自分へ束縛3が付く。弱点・脆弱属性: **Passive — Silence**: Taking damage gives Yi Sang 3 Bind next turn and enables a +20% damage bonus that turn when attacking an Attack Type or Sin affinity to which the target is Weak or Fatal, once per turn. Account for the 3 Bind he can receive.
messages.攻撃加重値1の単体向け。単体の敵に撃って攻撃威力減少とクイックを配り、後続の味方: With 1 Attack Weight, it is for a single target. Use it on an enemy to apply Attack Power Down and grant Haste, supporting the rest of the team.
messages.必要資源は怠惰3・憤怒1、精神消耗は10。侵蝕スキルはない。: Costs 3 Sloth, 1 Wrath, and 10 SP. Has no Corrosion skill.
messages.耐性は憂鬱・嫉妬が脆弱(×2)、怠惰が抵抗(×0.75)。: Sin resistances: Fatal to Gloom and Envy (×2); Endured against Sloth (×0.75).
messages.Ⅲ: 威力が上がり、攻撃威力減少が的中時に、クイックが3になる。: **Ⅲ**: Raises Power, changes Attack Power Down to an On Hit effect, and raises Haste to 3.
messages.Ⅳ: 束縛2が加わる。クイック3だけで足りる場面が多く、優先度は低いと考えられる: **Ⅳ**: Adds 2 Bind. The 3 Haste is often enough for its role, so this upgrade can be a lower priority.
messages.奥歯事務所フィクサー: S2が怠惰、S3が憤怒で、必要資源(怠惰3・憤怒1)をま: **[Molar Office Fixer](persona:0105)**: Sloth S2 and Wrath S3 can supply both required affinities: 3 Sloth and 1 Wrath.
messages.南部リウ協会3課: S1が怠惰、S2が憤怒で、同じく必要資源を出せる。: **[Liu Assoc. South Section 3](persona:0112)**: Sloth S1 and Wrath S2 also supply its required affinities.
